content_units: 3-Part Workout Soundtrack

A strong workout arc usually starts with groove and mobility, climbs into brighter/faster tracks for your hardest effort, then eases into smoother, lower-strain songs without dropping the mood completely.
Warm-Up to Cool-Down Sequence
Section   Artist   Song   Why it fits
Warm-up   Gorillaz   On Melancholy Hill   Soft, dreamy start for easy movement and loosening up
Warm-up   Tame Impala   The Less I Know The Better   Steady bass groove builds rhythm without spiking intensity
Warm-up   Daft Punk   Lose Yourself to Dance   Clean disco pulse for getting fully in motion
Warm-up   Robyn   Dancing On My Own   Emotional lift and stronger drive heading into work sets
Peak effort   Phoenix   Lisztomania   Fast, bright indie energy that raises momentum
Peak effort   M83   Midnight City   Big synth surge that feels expansive and motivating
Peak effort   Dua Lipa   Physical   Direct high-intensity push with obvious workout energy
Peak effort   Florence + The Machine   Dog Days Are Over   Explosive release for the biggest finish of the session
Cool-down   CHVRCHES   The Mother We Share   Still upbeat, but less aggressive after the peak
Cool-down   The Weeknd   Blinding Lights   Smooth, driving comedown with familiar pop momentum
Cool-down   MGMT   Electric Feel   Relaxed, swaying groove for lowering heart rate
Cool-down   LCD Soundsystem   All My Friends   Long-form emotional exhale to close the session
Energy Arc Rationale
Warm-up
The first four tracks gradually move from hazy and controlled into danceable and motivating.
-   On Melancholy Hill   opens with the lowest pressure.
-   The Less I Know The Better   adds pulse.
-   Lose Yourself to Dance   locks in cadence.
-   Dancing On My Own   gives you the emotional and rhythmic lift right before intensity rises.
Peak effort
These four are the workout engine.
-   Lisztomania   and   Midnight City   accelerate the mood and create forward motion.
-   Physical   is the most explicitly high-output track here.
-   Dog Days Are Over   works as the biggest emotional and percussive summit.
Cool-down
This section steps down in force without feeling flat.
-   The Mother We Share   keeps you moving while easing off.
-   Blinding Lights   maintains a light jog/spin energy.
-   Electric Feel   softens the edges.
-   All My Friends   is the best closing track because it feels reflective, spacious, and satisfying after effort.

This ordering is based on each song’s general feel, pacing, and workout-flow suitability rather than strict BPM matching.
